## Permit Clause
Anyone with a valid permit cannot have the relevant contraband seized and cannot be arrested for possession. A valid permit is outlined in [textlink="Permit Acquisition" link="security-sop-permitacquisition"].
If an item is found during a random search and its permit is missing required stamps, the officer can choose to escort the person to obtain the stamps, or take the item to the Warden to put in the Armory's contraband crate with a note for later retrieval. If found during a search conducted due to a crime, an incomplete permit is not valid and the item may be confiscated.
